scripts.text: ^3355FFWait a second! Right now, you're carrying too many items with you. Please come back after putting some of your things into Kafra Storage.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF等一下！您現在攜帶的物品太多了。請先將部分物品存入卡普拉倉庫，然後再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Jade]
Bring me two
Gemstones of the
same color, and I will
change them to Gemstones
of a different color.
scripts.translation:
[傑德]
帶來兩顆同色的魔力礦石，我就能幫你換成別的顏色。
藍色魔力礦石換成紅色魔力礦石！
紅色魔力礦石換成黃色魔力礦石！
黃色魔力礦石換成藍色魔力礦石！

scripts.text:
[Jade]
Hah...!
You're kidding me, right?
I can't provide you with this
service if you don't
give me at least
2 {0}s!
scripts.translation:
[傑德]
Hah...!
你在開玩笑吧？
至少得給我2個{0}，才能兌換！

scripts.text:
[Jade]
I believe I can create
a total of {0} {1}s
using the {2}s
that you currently have.
What do you want to do?
scripts.translation:
[傑德]
我認為利用您目前擁有的{2}，
總共可以製作出{0}個{1}。
您想怎麼做？

scripts.text: Give me as many as you can.
I want to set the amount.

[Jade]
So how many
do you want?
The maximum number
that you can enter is 100.
scripts.translation:
[傑德]
那麼您想要多少個？
您可以輸入的最大數量是100。

scripts.text:
[Jade]
None at all?
I guess you
changed your mind...
scripts.translation:
[傑德]
一個都不要？
看來您改變主意了...

scripts.text:
[Jade]
Errm...
I asked you to enter
an amount no greater
than 100, remember...?
scripts.translation:
[傑德]
嗯...我說過，數量不能超過100，記得嗎...？

scripts.text:
[Jade]
Errm...
You don't have that
many gems to trade...
scripts.translation:
[傑德]
嗯...你沒有那麼多魔力礦石可供兌換...

scripts.text:
[Jade]
Sure, no problem.
Come back any time.
scripts.translation:
[傑德]
沒問題。
隨時歡迎回來。

scripts.text:
[Jade]
There you go.
Feel free to come
back any time.
Hm, what's that look for?
Is there something on my face?
scripts.translation:
[傑德]
給你，隨時歡迎再來。
嗯，幹嗎這麼看著我？我臉上有東西嗎？
